comment: Pinned content sources for the PF1e converter (plan §1.1 / gap G-44). Every entry is a git checkout at an exact commit with a sparse path set; `pnpm content:fetch` materialises them under tools/content/vendor/ (git-ignored) so `pnpm content:convert` can run. Licenses are the verified facts recorded in tools/adopt/INVENTORY.md — input to a case, not a verdict.

sources.usage: Data only — per-entry YAML packs are converted; no system code is transferred (INVENTORY row 2, transfer approach: clean-room transcription for logic).
Data only — per-entry JSON packs are converted with the OGL notice and CREDITS (INVENTORY row 1).
